About Me

I'm Shauryyan Kumar, a BCA student at CT Group of Institutions, Sahpur, Jalandhar — passionate about programming and building things with code.

I work primarily with Python. I've completed the Kushal Yuva Program (KYP) and earned certifications from GUVI HCL in Python and web development.

Cybersecurity is something I'm genuinely interested in and plan to learn seriously in the future. Right now I'm focused on strengthening my programming fundamentals and building real projects.
